titles.native: ドリームレス・ドリームス

description:
Music video for the song Dreamless Dreams, directed, animated, and musically written by Harumaki Gohan, featuring vocals by Hatsune Miku.

Note: There exists two versions of this song; the first being a vocaloid version featuring Hatsune Miku uploaded on May 6, 2017 and a self-cover version by Harumaki Gohan, which was uploaded later on May 14, 2017.
